prayerExcerpt.en-US: "How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!" says Our Saviour; because they are bound to earth by the strong ties of their riches.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Quão dificilmente entrarão no reino de Deus os que têm riquezas!", diz Nosso Salvador; porque estão presos à terra pelos fortes laços de suas riquezas.

meta.face: An Alexandrian of about sixty-five, sturdy, with a warm olive complexion and a ROUND, FULL face — a broad, rounded forehead with short, thick grey hair receding a little at the temples, FULL, rounded cheeks, a SHORT, broad nose with a ROUNDED tip, LARGE, dark, heavy-lidded eyes under softly ARCHED black-and-grey brows, a small, full mouth; a FULL, ROUNDED grey beard of medium length, curling at the edges; the gaze steady and fatherly, toward us. Not the oblong, high-nosed cyril_alexandria, the bald, long-bearded athanasius, the broad-domed lucian_antioch, or the short-bearded, narrow Gregory Thaumaturgus of this batch.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The Painter's Manual describes him as 'an old man with a rounded beard', which the card keeps (the fresco on English Wikipedia shows him with a full, rounded greyish beard); the palm is for the Martyrology's 'last victim of the great persecution'.
